title: Pernod Ricard agrees co-branded RTD for Malibu with Dole - Global Drinks Intel
summary: Pernod Ricard agrees co-branded RTD for Malibu with Dole Global Drinks Intel
ai_summary: Pernod Ricard agrees co-branded RTD for Malibu with Dole Global Drinks Intel — This report announces Pernod Ricard’s agreement to produce a co-branded ready-to-drink product for Malibu in partnership with Dole, according to Global Drinks Intel. It highlights the collaboration’s strategic importance for both brands.
